faq.a: No outside food or drinks are permitted, except you can bring your own cake or cupcakes.

faq.q: What ages are birthday packages for?
faq.a: Party packages are strictly for guests ages 17 & under. The listed guest count does not include parents/adults. Over 17? Contact our Special Events Manager.

faq.q: Is there a weekday party discount?
faq.a: 30% off weekday parties (Monday – Thursday) with coupon code SURGE30 at checkout. Does not apply to any bowling parties.

faq.q: What is the deposit and cancellation policy?
faq.a: A $100 non-refundable deposit is required to secure your reservation if not paid in full at booking; the remaining balance is collected on arrival. In the event of a cancellation, party deposits are non-refundable and cannot be applied to other activities.

faq.q: How far ahead must we book or make changes?
faq.a: Parties must be booked a minimum of 48 hours from the event date. Changes may be made no less than 24 hours prior to the original scheduled date and are subject to availability.

faq.q: Can we pick a party room?
faq.a: Party rooms are first come, first serve. Include your preference in the reservation notes. Rooms have 3 tables and 20 chairs, with themes such as Princess & The Frog, LSU Football, Dinosaurs, Saints Football and Space.

Age-appropriate decorations only. No tape, nails, adhesives (including Command strips), glitter or confetti. Balloon arches must be fully assembled by guests. All decorations must be removed at the end. Party room entry is not allowed before your scheduled start time.

faq.q: Do I need a reservation for sports simulators or laser tag?
faq.a: Simulators: walk-ins are welcome or reserve online. Laser tag: no reservations required.

faq.q: Is sports equipment provided at the simulators?
faq.a: Sports equipment is available to use with a security deposit.
Kitchen opens at 4 PM Mon.–Thurs. and 11 AM Fri–Sun, except on select holidays when hours may vary.
